note: Values for the enums the platform builds in. These are the AOT enums with no AxEnum file in PackagesLocalDirectory - on 10.0.2645.32, 47 of them, carrying 55% of all enum references, NoYes among them. The AOS ships each one as an AxEnum_<Name>.xml document embedded in Microsoft.Dynamics.AX.Metadata.dll, so this file is generated from that assembly by scripts/extract-kernel-enums.mjs and checked in, keeping the extension self-contained. A label that starts with @ is a label id (@sys####); it is shown only once it resolves. A missing enum means the value list is unknown rather than empty.
